# Published builds: v0.1.0 (4e7652a), v0.1.1 (ee67d3a), v0.2.0 (86c0280) and v0.3.0 (c3a1f7f,
# cameraunlock-core 3465659), each a GitHub release with an installer and a Nexus ZIP. No dev
# pre-release. The oracle is v0.3.0's reader. The frozen reader is src/core/config.cpp's reading

# its config.h differs from v0.3.0's in where six defaults are spelled (core's constants, the same
# values) and in the value of one, InvertZ.
